_doc: MRIS crisis-model config (ORDER-200). ADVISORY-ONLY layer inspired by bond-crisis-dashboard-v2. Each model is a 0-100 composite of explainable components; every component is a clamped LINEAR RAMP between a 'calm' anchor (score 0) and a 'stress' anchor (score 100). Direction is inferred from the anchors (stress>calm = rising is bad; stress<calm = falling is bad). These scores DO NOT feed the validated RI/state that MacroGate reads on real accounts (doctrine: advisory shadow until backtested + user-ratified). Zero LLM tokens. All anchors are plain tunable numbers.
_locked: Anchors seeded by Opus-seat 2026-07-24 from historical episode reasoning (see _rationale). NOT yet backtest-validated - these produce a DISPLAY score only until ORDER-200 Phase-B proves them on 2020/2022/2024.

labels._doc: score bands -> label (matches the vercel site vocabulary).

fold_policy._doc: ORDER-200 Phase D. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the crisis fold - read by BOTH mris_export_regime.ps1 (which actually writes the state MacroGate reads) and mris_fold_costcheck.ps1 (which estimates its cost). Keeping the ladder here instead of duplicated in two scripts is deliberate: a cost estimate that silently describes a different policy than the one that runs is worse than no estimate.
fold_policy._ladder_doc: One notch, downward only. RISK_OFF/STRESS deliberately absent = the fold can never manufacture STRESS; that stays owned by the validated 8-barometer layer.

models.name: YIELD_SHOCK
models.title_th: Yield ช็อก (ดอกเบี้ยพุ่ง หุ้นร่วง)
models._rationale: US10Y rising hard while equities break down and bond vol (MOVE) is elevated = a duration/rate shock. Matches the site's #1 model on 2026-07-24.

models.name: CREDIT_STRESS
models.title_th: ความเครียดสินเชื่อ (สเปรด HY กว้าง)
models._rationale: High-yield credit spread high AND widening, confirmed by the HYG/IEF credit-risk-appetite ratio, rising bond vol and equity fear = credit/bank-run stress. This is the core bond-crisis axis the site leads with; our old 8-barometer set had NO credit axis at all (the 2026-07-24 divergence vs the site).
models._anchor_evidence: CREDITPX anchors are MEASURED, not guessed (ORDER-200 Phase-C probe over 2016-2026): worst pct_vs_sma200 / worst 5d = covid_2020 -26.2%/-14.2% · inflation_2022 -5.5%/-3.8% · calm_2019 -5.7%/-2.8% · svb_2023mar -2.8%/-5.7% (the 5d leg is what catches a bank shock the trend leg misses) · yield_spike_2023 +2.4%/-1.2% (correctly reads as NOT a credit event). Stress anchors set at -15% (trend) and -8% (5d) so covid saturates while 2022/2019 stay mid-scale.

components.desc: HYG/IEF credit ratio vs its SMA200 (falling = stress)

models.name: INFLATION_OIL
models.title_th: เงินเฟ้อ-น้ำมัน (น้ำมันพุ่ง ดอกเบี้ยขึ้น)
models._rationale: Oil surging above trend with upward momentum, confirmed by rising yields = inflation-driven regime. Matches the site's inflation-oil model. WTI vs its own SMA200 avoids a hardcoded price level.
